7. Data Privacy, Encryption & HIPAA Security Safeguards
To maintain rigorous compliance with HIPAA Title II administrative and security standards, all patient health
information (PHI) undergoes automated de-identification prior to secondary telemetry transmission. The
de-identification protocol complies with the HIPAA Safe Harbor Method, systematically stripping all 18 designated
personal identifiers, including patient names, geographic codes below state level, dates, and medical record numbers
(MRNs).
8. Cryptographic Protocols & Access Control
